summary: Added CI workflow (vault-drift.yml) + check script (check_vault_drift.sh) that executes CC#48 meta-check on every push to main and PR that touches vault files. Closes the gap where 52 vault CCs only ran manually during SDDK cycles — now a regression in vault files fails CI before merge.
title: 64 vault drift CI workflow

subject.gap: The 52 vault CCs only ran manually during SDDK cycles (verify phase). A new regression in vault files would not be caught until the next session's drift sweep — typically days later.
subject.fix: CI workflow (.github/workflows/vault-drift.yml) executes CC#48 meta-check on every push to main and PR touching vault files. The check_vault_drift.sh script is the entry point.
